items.title: Carson Beck, Haynes King Take Center Stage In Hall Of Fame Game
items.summary: Rookie quarterbacks Carson Beck and Haynes King gave fans a Hall of Fame Game performance they won't soon forget.

items.title: Uefa says boycott may still go ahead as FA withdraws Infantino support
items.summary: Fifa's backing of president Gianni Infantino at a meeting on Wednesday "changes nothing", says European governing body Uefa.

items.title: Spirit eliminated after losing fiery match against MI London
items.summary: London Spirit become the first team to be eliminated from The Hundred after a four-wicket defeat by MI London in front of a record crowd at Lord's.
items.whyItMatters: Cricket gives XLB a stronger India-relevant sports lane and a reason for repeat sports check-ins.
